title: Matching and recovery: scope and price
intro: This quote includes the batch reader, matching, receipt recovery and an operating runbook. The table also shows optional work and alerts that have not been selected.

options.name: Matching and recovery
options.summary: Test matching and recovery from a lost ledger response before production posting.

matrix.name: Batch reader
matrix.description: Read the completed billing export and retain its source identifiers.

matrix.name: Matching rules
matrix.description: Compare account, order, amount and currency using approved rules.

matrix.name: Receipt recovery
matrix.description: Check whether the ledger accepted the original posting before retrying.

matrix.name: Exception record
matrix.description: Show the conflicting values, owner and correction history.

matrix.name: Operational alerts
matrix.description: Notify finance when a batch stalls or held items remain.

matrix.name: Operating runbook
matrix.description: Name who can stop posting and explain how to check requests already sent to the ledger.

matrix.name: Finance training
matrix.description: Teach the finance team how to review held records and rerun them after correction.
